name: Summon Lesser nature Spirit
description: (Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Summon a lesser nature spirit, requiring sufficient fertile ground nearby, such as Junimo, Lesser Dryads, maneater plants, Ents, etc. Limited to Uncommon familiar power or less; strength depends on your power. It draws on your energy to stay manifested and use abilities, unsummoning if unfueled, but with proper skills, time, and energy you can make it permanent.
